designer.generationPromptTemplate: Use the blank clear-PVC backpack base and front print-area guide as strict construction and placement references. The translucent teal marking is only a print-area guide and must never appear in the result. Apply requested artwork only on the front clear-PVC panel inside the outlined printable area. Keep the back clear and unprinted. Preserve the transparent PVC body, realistic clear material and reflections, original silhouette and proportions, black zipper and binding, zipper pulls, shoulder straps, top handle, black mesh side pockets, stitching, and white studio background. Do not add a white printed rectangle or background unless the customer explicitly requests one. Do not print on black trim, zipper, straps, handle, or mesh pockets. Show a realistic product view.
